_about: TODO-30 turn 8 (AB-11, AB-13): versioned ambient manifest for run_seeds.py --manifest. Same schema as manifest.json / manifest-ambient-v1.json. AB-11 protocol: gate_selection_v2 (F128[1:65] — turn 7's selection seeds, whose first 64 null repeats per configuration reproduce turn 7's selection — with 1024 null repeats per seed = 65 536 per configuration) -> select_thresholds.py --rule inclusive writes gate-thresholds-v2.json -> its SHA-256 is pinned in gate_validation_v2's overrides BEFORE any validation run -> gate_validation_v2 (F256[128:256], 128 seeds used for nothing before; 64 null repeats = 8192 per configuration, 300 source repeats per condition) -> aggregate_gate.py. Turn 7's validation seeds O128[0:128] are not used by the gate families of this manifest. AB-13 families ev12_antimask, ev02_fov, ev15_separation, ev01_sweep: montecarlo ambient-evidence on a clone of their request (Seed, RepoRoot replaced), each with the N of its legacy family; aggregate with ambient/aggregate_ev.py.

families.evidence: AB-11 threshold re-selection: 64 seeds x 1024 background-only acquisitions per configuration (65 536); the first 64 per seed are turn 7's
AB-11 re-validation (128 x 64 = 8192 background-only acquisitions per configuration) and the EV-07 / EV-09 count gates with the re-selected thresholds (300 repeats per condition)
EV-12 under the absolute field (legacy family antimask, N = 128): single / calibrated / mask-antimask at equal time, 400 net source counts, t = 10 / 60 s, 200 repeats
EV-02 under the absolute field (legacy family fov, F128, N = 64): 1 m / 5 m, x / diagonal, 0-20 deg, N0 500 / 5000, t = 10 / 60 s, open window, flag re-calibrated on separate draws
EV-15 under the absolute field (legacy families mixedstrip N = 64, spatial N = 128): Cs 1 Bq + Co 8 Bq at the literal live time of the legacy photon budget, stripping and spatial location
EV-01 under the absolute field (legacy families sweep / sweep_head N = 64, precise N = 32) at the scenarios' 1 MBq and 1 s, plus the AB-12 decoder-pull baseline (cross-correlation and MLEM)
